title: Mulesoft Developer or Architect
full_description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MuleSoft Developer or Architect based in India. We are looking for an experienced MuleSoft Developer or Architect to design, build, and maintain robust integrations between Salesforce and external systems. In this fully remote, individual-contributor role, you will help deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions in a healthcare and life sciences environment. You will take ownership of integration architecture, API development, technical documentation, and production support. Working closely with architects, developers, business analysts, and client stakeholders, you will translate complex business needs into effective technical solutions. Your work will support secure health data exchange, platform interoperability, and continuous improvement across enterprise applications. This is an opportunity to contribute to impactful technology projects within a collaborative, cross-functional delivery environment. Accountabilities Design, develop, deploy, and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and APIs. Build MuleSoft APIs and integration services using API-led connectivity patterns, REST/SOAP services, and messaging solutions where appropriate. Define integration architecture and standards, including security, scalability, error handling, retries, idempotency, and monitoring. Produce and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, data mappings, sequence diagrams, and operational runbooks. Develop Salesforce integration components using Connected Apps, OAuth, Named Credentials, External Services, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture. Support batch and near-real-time data synchronization, transformations, and data quality controls. Work with client stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify system dependencies, and guide technical decisions. Collaborate with Salesforce architects, developers, business analysts, project management teams, and QA to deliver end-to-end solutions. Support regulated delivery practices, including appropriate HIPAA/PHI handling, auditability, change control, and release governance. Contribute to CI/CD and deployment processes through source control, branching strategies, automated testing, and release pipelines. Troubleshoot production integration issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive improvements. Requirements 5+ years of experience in integration development and/or integration architecture. Hands-on MuleSoft experience delivering integrations across design, development, deployment, and support using Anypoint Platform. Proven experience integrating Salesforce with external systems, including Salesforce APIs, authentication methods, and platform eventing. Required healthcare experience, including handling, securing, and transferring health-related data. Strong understanding of API design, data mapping, transformation, error handling, retries, idempotency, and monitoring. Knowledge of security fundamentals, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, TLS, certificate management, and least-privilege access. Experience with synchronous and asynchronous integration approaches, including the ability to assess reliability and performance trade-offs. Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and collaboration across onshore and offshore teams. Strong client-facing communication skills and the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders. Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer I certification or equivalent practical experience. Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator I certification or equivalent practical experience. Nice To Have Experience with Dell Boomi or Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services in addition to MuleSoft. Salesforce Platform Integration Architect or Platform Developer I certifications. Salesforce Health Cloud experience or Health Cloud Accredited Professional accreditation. Experience integrating life sciences platforms such as Veeva or IQVIA, as well as identity and Master Data Management (MDM) solutions. Familiarity with event streaming and message brokers such as Kafka, JMS, or cloud-native queues. Exposure to validated system delivery, including requirements traceability, test evidence, and audit readiness. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement from India. Individual-contributor role with no travel requirements. Opportunities to work on healthcare and life sciences technology solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams across onshore and offshore locations. Opportunities to develop technical expertise and contribute to integration architecture and delivery practices.
